name: plumb
description: A durable memory wiki for Claude Code. Plumb stores what you decide and why in a local markdown wiki, indexes it with hybrid vector + keyword retrieval, injects the relevant pages into every prompt automatically, and gives Claude tools to read, search, and update it. Runs entirely on your machine: no cloud, no account, no data leaving the host.

wiki_root.title: Wiki location
wiki_root.description: Where your markdown wiki lives. Leave blank for ~/.plumb/wiki.

service_url.title: Search service URL
service_url.description: Where the local retrieval service listens. Leave blank for http://127.0.0.1:18795. Point this at an existing service if you already run one.

idle_timeout_minutes.title: Idle shutdown (minutes)
idle_timeout_minutes.description: The search service starts on demand and stops itself after this long with no queries, handing back about 300 MB. Set 0 to keep it resident.
